title: Chapter 9 The Era Of Universal Cultivation
content:
Chapter 9 The Era Of Universal Cultivation

Suddenly, Gu Chen's aura began to surge wildly, and waves of pressure unique to the Heavenly Emperor Realm surged out of Gu Chen's body like a tide. In just a moment, the faces of everyone in the entire deserted city changed drastically.

Gu Chen was stunned on the spot, and then burst into laughter.

He looked up at the sky and turned his head and said, "City Lord, I'm troubled by you."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled, and then waved his hand, and a gap suddenly appeared on the deserted city.

"Go."

"Thank you, City Lord."

The next moment, Gu Chen soared into the sky and flew into the void.

At the same time, the entire Tianxuan world began to buzz.

Countless old monsters who were sleeping in seclusion were awakened by this strange phenomenon. Seeing that the aura full of the avenue in the void of the Tianxuan world was constantly gathering in the same direction, everyone looked extremely horrified.

Someone is going to prove the way of the Heavenly Emperor? !

How is this possible? The Tianxuan world has not been out of the Heavenly Emperor Realm for many years.

After being shocked, those old monsters were already in tears.

It turned out that the Tianxuan world was not in decline, and they could also cultivate a Heavenly Emperor in their Tianxuan world.

After just a little feeling, they determined the location of the mysterious strong man who had achieved the Heavenly Emperor.

That was the direction of Huangzhou.

Without hesitation, several old monsters took the valuable gifts and dragged their families to the direction of Huangzhou.

And the rest of the cultivators were shocked when they saw the strange phenomenon in Huangzhou again.

Not long ago, a picture of a huge city full of supreme aura suddenly appeared in their minds. They could vaguely see an ancient plaque above the city gate, which read-Huangcheng.

And now, such a strange phenomenon appeared in the direction of Huangzhou again, including the previous ice phoenix phantom, all appeared from there.

There is no doubt that Huangzhou has undergone huge changes.

The cultivators who did nothing at the beginning immediately began to rush towards Huangzhou without stopping.

And the speed of the cultivators who had already gone there at the beginning also suddenly accelerated a few points.

That was an opportunity.

It must be an opportunity for their Tianxuan world.

At this time, above the deserted city.

After an unknown period of time, the aura of the Great Dao finally began to slowly dissipate, and Gu Chen's aura also reached its peak in history.

In such an environment in the deserted city, it is really not too easy to prove the Dao of the Heavenly Emperor.

Of course, this is also because Gu Chen has a profound foundation.

A million years in the Evil God Abyss is not as simple as sleeping. In addition, Lu Daosheng gave all the essence left by the evil demons to Gu Chen before, even if there is no deserted city now.

It is only a matter of time for Gu Chen to prove the Dao of the Heavenly Emperor.

Above the void, Gu Chen slowly opened his eyes, exerted a little force, and suddenly, countless cracks appeared in the entire void.

Feeling the current power, Gu Chen showed a long-lost smile.

At this time, Gu Chen remembered something, and then his body trembled and went directly back to the deserted city.

"City Lord."

Seeing Lu Daosheng again, Gu Chen's heart trembled again.

I have now reached the Heavenly Emperor Realm, and I don't know how much stronger I am than before, but now I still can't see Lu Daosheng at all.

Originally, when I was in the Evil God Abyss, I thought Lu Daosheng was a Heavenly Emperor Realm expert, and no matter how strong he was, he was just an expert above the Heavenly Emperor Realm.

But now, Gu Chen knows that he is short-sighted.

Then, Gu Chen bowed deeply to Lu Daosheng.

"City Lord, from today on, I, Gu Chen, am willing to follow you forever and ever and serve the Desolate City."

There is nothing wrong with such a person, for Gu Chen to surrender.

Without Lu Daosheng, his ending would only be to sit in the Evil God Abyss, not to mention that this place is so fragrant, what reason do he have to leave.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly and said, "Okay, you just need to teach my daughter well and don't teach her bad things."

Hearing this, Gu Chen nodded heavily.

"Don't worry, City Lord. From now on, I will treat Xiaoxue as my own daughter."

As soon as the voice fell, Lu Xue's voice sounded from a distance.

"My dear father!"

Lu Xue ran over in a panic and threw herself into Lu Daosheng's arms.

Seeing Lu Xue, Lu Daosheng immediately showed a loving smile.

He touched Lu Xue's little head and smiled, "Xiaoxue, what's wrong?"

Lu Xue raised her head with grievance in her eyes.

"Dad, you have kept it from me so hard. Did you do this to make the deserted city look like this now?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded and said, "Yes, it was your father who did it."

Hearing this, Lu Xue snorted and said, "You are not as simple as a peerless strong man, Dad, you..."

"What?"

"Dad, you are not the legendary saint, are you?"

Saints, that is a legendary existence, this is the most powerful existence she can think of.

On the side, Gu Chen heard this and said with a smile: "Xiaoxue, stop mocking your father."

"Mockery, what's wrong with me?"

When Lu Xue saw Gu Chen, she immediately restrained herself a little, but her face was still aggrieved.

Seeing Lu Xue like this, Lu Daosheng and Gu Chen both laughed.

"Xiaoxue, your father is much stronger than that saint."

But how much stronger, he didn't know.

When he hadn't achieved the status of Heavenly Emperor, he could control the saint with one hand.

Not to mention Lu Daosheng, who was countless times stronger than himself.

Above the saint, there is the saint king, above the saint king, there is the quasi emperor, and above the quasi emperor, there is the great emperor.

Hearing this, Lu Xue's mouth suddenly opened wide, her face full of disbelief.

Her father was actually stronger than the saint.

At this time, Lu Daosheng spoke.

"Xiaoxue, next, you have to follow your master Gu Chen to practice well, daddy I will be away for a while."

"Ah? Daddy, where are you going?"

Seeing Lu Xue's reaction, Lu Daosheng smiled helplessly.

"I'm just going out for a walk, don't worry, I will be back soon."

"Oh, okay, then you hurry up."

"Okay, don't worry, I only have you as a precious daughter, how can I abandon you."

Hearing this, Lu Xue immediately showed a sweet smile.

On the side, Gu Chen hesitated and said: "City Lord, you, "

Lu Daosheng waved his hand, next you just need to comfort and practice, the deserted city will not be disturbed now.

"Yes, City Lord, I will definitely guide Xiaoxue in her cultivation."

"Xiaoxue, you too, must listen to your Master Gu Chen."

"Yes, I know, Dad."

Then, Gu Chen took Lu Xue and disappeared on the spot.

At the spot, Lu Daosheng shook his head.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng's figure appeared in the sky above the deserted city, and it seemed to be magnified countless times.

Seeing Lu Daosheng, everyone in the deserted city exclaimed.

"City Lord! It's the City Lord!"

"City Lord, what's going on?"

"City Lord! Hurry, tell us, this is all your work."

Hearing the cheers of the crowd, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly.

"Don't panic, everyone, these are indeed done by me."

Hearing this, everyone in the deserted city cheered immediately.

"City Lord is awesome!"

At this time, Lu Daosheng pressed his hand, and everyone stopped.

"Next, everyone should practice well. I believe that with the current conditions, our Desolate City is not inferior to any force in the outside world."

"Don't worry, City Lord. With these conditions, I, Old Li, will sooner or later be able to break through to the Concentrated Spirit Realm!"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng looked a little embarrassed.

This ambition is a bit too ambitious.

He remembered that it was Old Li who sold meat in the city, and his wild boar meat was the most delicious in the city.

After all, he was the only meat seller in the Desolate City.

He had visited it many times.
